rows.remains: A replay digest that consumes the disciplined clock needs a platform replay path with a production caller. The only consumer is the deep brain tick desk, which stays off until the deep brain reads a real lake (ADR 0151, ADR 0723 decision 3a: the lake route is the owner's choice). A digest function only its own test calls does not count, so no slice was built. The lake_clock.rs digest tests already exist and were not re-claimed.

Owner ruling 2026-10-31 and ADR 0146 decision 5 hold rumour structural and decline the sentence-to-citation binder; RUMOUR_PHRASES stays a vocabulary floor with a named paraphrase miss. Closing the miss means reopening an existing ADR (protected).

ADR 0712 decisions 3 and 8: the per-world payoff of a decision and the conviction level counted as high uncertainty are risk-desk figures, none chosen. Decision 6: enabling the discovery desk (every_cycles above zero) is an owner config and budget choice, so no observation can execute from code alone.

Not attempted. Embeddings, novelty, entities, relationships, summaries and episodes need a representation and a persistence design (event log vs blob store) no decision record settles, and a restart test across them. No ADR 0703-0723 decides this row. A slice was not built.

ADR 0155 decision 20 meets the declaration clause with a truthfully empty extension. A production caller of submit_native would be a new order-placement path whose use of post_only is a trading-policy choice, guarded by the order_placement_paths suite; no decision record makes that choice. No DEX adapter exists.
